page.title: Set up Wi-Fi
page.intro: Choose the Wi-Fi ReceiptPi should join and enter its password.
page.none_found: No networks found. Enter the name below by hand.
page.password_hint: Leave empty for an open network.
page.connecting_text: ReceiptPi is now joining "{network}". This setup Wi-Fi closes while it does. If it works, ReceiptPi prints a receipt with its address. If not, the setup Wi-Fi opens again and a note is printed.
error.no_network: Please choose a network or enter a name.
error.name_long: The network name is too long (at most 32 bytes).
error.password: The password must be 8 to 63 characters long.
error.expired: This page has expired. Please try again.
